title.en: Attentive care for cats and dogs

text.en: Pet parents express complete confidence in the sitters' handling of both cats and dogs during travel. Reviewers note that sitters attend carefully to shy cats hiding under furniture, administer scheduled medications, and provide gentle care for elderly dogs. Clients frequently return home to calm, comfortable pets that received dedicated personal attention.

title.en: Detailed daily updates and visit photos

text.en: Clients consistently appreciate receiving prompt reports and cheerful photographs after every dog walk or sitting visit. Owners highlight the reassurance provided by detailed check-in notes, which confirm feeding times, water refills, and pet moods. Reviewers note that the team communicates promptly regarding schedule changes and arrival windows.

Reviewers praise the sitting staff for their reliability, punctuality, and strict adherence to client instructions. Owners value the presence of qualified veterinary technicians on the team, especially when caring for sick or recovering animals requiring specialized care. Many clients emphasize the sitters' willingness to accommodate shifting schedules.

q.en: Do pet sitters provide daily photos and updates?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently receive detailed visit reports along with photos confirming their pets' wellbeing.

q.en: Can sitters administer medications to sick pets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight that the team includes veterinary technicians capable of managing special medical routines.

q.en: Are sitting visits available for both dogs and cats?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly use the service for dog walking, daycare transportation, and in-home cat visits.
